_comment: Combined anchor spec: per-scene VO start times (scene tiling + scene-relative cue math) plus every in-scene cue, including the 17 frozen cues from anchors.json. Resolve with tools/word_anchors.py transcript.json --spec anchors.build.json -o anchors.js --lead-in 3.0 (3.0s = the silent bumper before the VO). Phrases are punctuation-free so they match ASR word tokens; note the ASR heard 'Vantage' as 'Advantage', 'Lochsa' as 'Loxa' and 'Nimiipuu' as 'Nemepu', so those beats anchor to neighbouring words.
